proposed_paradise_conversion.goal: Ensure all 239 paradise meshes render on Melodia masters with textures visible.
steps: Read each MI_Rooms_Paradise_*_Art instance's parent via editor (get_editor_property('parent')).

For instances NOT on M_Master_Toon_Universal: reparent to Universal (opaque) or Alpha (if the prop has transparency cutout — e.g. Vase_Large_Outline_Art, NFT_Frame01_Outliner, SciFi_Drone_Atlas_01_Trans).

Route textures: for _<PackMIC>-suffixed instances, route the matching pack texture (Atlas_01_Mat instances -> T_Atlas_01_Albedo; Seam_Sand_Mat instances -> T_Seam_Sand_Albedo; etc.) onto Albedo + set TextureWeight=1.0 + LayerA_TextureWeight=1.0.

For pure _Art instances (no pack suffix): if a T_<PropName>_Base/Albedo texture exists in the CrystalCrossroads import set, route it; otherwise set BaseTint from the prop's GLB baseColorFactor or leave white (_defaultMat convention).
Set ShadowDream soft blue #8AA0D6 / pink #E8A0BF (strength 0.7) on all paradise instances per project convention.
Save all instances + re-read parent to confirm.
